articles.summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. (GIL: TSX and NYSE) (“Gildan” or the “Company”) today announced results for the second quarter ended June 28, 2026, and updated its full year 2026 guidance.
articles.title: Gildan Reports Strong Second Quarter Results, Updates its Full Year 2026 Guidance and Announces the Sale of HanesBrands Australia

articles.summary: Employees from Gildan’s head office recently volunteered at FitSpirit’s Montreal spring celebration event, welcoming over 4,000 girls from schools around Montreal, encouraging them to engage in sports and physical activity.
articles.title: Gildan Celebrates Girls in Sports in Partnership with FitSpirit Montreal

articles.summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. will report its 2026 second quarter financial and operating results on Thursday, July 30, 2026. A press release will be issued before markets open, and a conference call is scheduled on that same day at 8:30 AM ET to discuss the Company’s results.
articles.title: Gildan Activewear Announces Date for Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
